x-sourcePrecedence.node: defaults -> explicit file -> environment -> data-dir anchoring -> typed/policy validation; CLI selects file/data directory
x-sourcePrecedence.game: inherited environment -> optional game .env fills absent keys only -> schema -> DB selection -> ASGI
x-sourcePrecedence.publisher: process environment -> explicit env/secret source -> allowed public settings -> explicit CLI overrides -> schema; plaintext credential input is forbidden for live publish

x-unknownPolicy: Unknown QC_ keys are rejected; QC_TEST_ is reserved for isolated test controllers. Other OS/service namespaces are left alone.
